Tools

Simple tools to help you get known

Correct a text, prepare a photo, post to your networks, find out what to improve on a page: Lia helps you, and you stay in charge. The tools are in your client area, from the Chico plan at €5 a month.

Open my toolsTry the demo

Lia’s tools

They are in your client area: you only need to be logged in. Nothing else to install, no other account to create.

Social networks

Post everywhereYou give a photo and a few words, then you post to all your networks from the same page. With your own text, it is free. Lia can also adapt it to each network, with the hashtags.
Post ideasNo more blank page: Lia suggests seven posts for your business, one a day, each with its text ready to copy. She leaves a word in square brackets where your own detail should go.

Texts

Correct a textYou paste a text. Lia corrects the mistakes and nothing else: your words and your tone stay the same. She shows you every correction.
Rewrite a textYou paste a text and choose what you want: clearer, shorter, warmer, more professional. Lia rewrites it without changing what it says and without making anything up.
Translate a textYou paste a text and choose the language. Lia translates it without touching names, prices or opening hours. She points out the words to have checked.
Reply to a customerYou paste the message you received and say in a few words what you want to answer. Lia writes the reply for an e-mail, and a short version for a text message. For a reminder or an announcement, leave the message empty.
Product listingA photo or a few words about your product: Lia writes a title, a catchy opening line and a clear description for your shop. She never makes up a price, a size or a material.

Photos

Announcement imageYou write a title, you choose a colour or one of your photos, and you download an image ready to post. Everything happens on your device, and it is free. If you are stuck, Lia finds the words.Free
Crop and lighten a photoYou choose a photo. It is cropped to the right size for Instagram, stories, Facebook, LinkedIn and your Google Business Profile, and a light version is prepared for your website. You download the ones you want. Nothing leaves your device.Free
Advice on a photoYou send a photo of a product or of your work. Lia tells you what works and the simple steps to retake it better with your phone: light, background, framing. She advises, she does not edit the photo.
Copy out the text from a photoYou take a photo of a chalkboard, a price list, a menu or a poster. Lia copies out the text line by line, without changing anything. She points out the words and numbers she cannot read well.

My website

Advice for my pageYou give the address of a page on your website. Lia reads its text and tells you what a visitor understands, the three things to change first and what is missing. She also suggests the title and description for Google. She reads the text, not the look or the speed.
QR codeA QR code to your website, to print on your cards, your shop window or your flyers. Your customers point their phone at it and land on your site.Free

Reviews

Reply to a reviewYou paste a customer’s review. Lia writes a short, polite reply, whether the review is good or bad. You copy it to your Google Business Profile.
Google review linkA ready-made link to send to your customers after a sale or a job. It opens the page to leave a review on your Google Business Profile directly. Send it to all your customers, without offering anything in return: that is Google’s rule.Free

Post everywhere

All your networks, from one page

Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon, X, your Google Business Profile, TikTok: you write only once, and you post everywhere without leaving the page.

  1. You link your accounts, just once. In the tool, on the “My networks” line.
  2. You give a photo and a few words. For example: “New spring bouquet, available Saturday”.
  3. You keep your own text, or Lia adapts it. With your own, posting costs no tokens. Lia can write one version per network: the right tone, the right length, the hashtags.
  4. You read it over, then you post. One button per network, or “Post everything”: the photo and the text go out to your linked accounts. Nothing is sent without you.
  5. A network is not linked? The text is copied and the network opens: you only have to paste. On a phone, “Share” sends the photo and the text to the app you choose.

Your questions about the client area

How do I request a change?

From your client area: you write what you want to change, with a photo if needed. You choose who handles it: Lia or Alex. I take care of the rest.

How long does it take?

I reply within 72 working hours, and within 24 hours with Titan. A small change is usually live within that time. I let you know as soon as it is done.

How is my account created?

Automatically, as soon as your order is confirmed. You can also create it beforehand, without ordering anything, on the My account page. Either way, you receive an email with a link to choose your password. If an account already existed with your address, the order is simply linked to it.

Can my account be deleted?

Only if it is no longer used: no login for 12 months and no active plan. I warn you by email 30 days before, and simply logging in cancels it all. As long as your plan is running, your account stays.

Is the client area paid?

No. It is included with your plan: change requests, dashboard, referral and invoices.
